0 = 没走到 HTTP（网络不通 / 地址解析失败）: 0 = request never reached HTTP (network unreachable / DNS resolution failed)
Claude 系列大模型接入。为工作流的 LLM 节点、对话测试台与网关提供推理: Integration for the Claude model family. Provides inference for the workflow's LLM node, the chat test console, and the model gateway.
Form=inline 时是 data URL；Form=uri 时是地址: A data URL when Form=inline; a URL when Form=uri
inline=data URL；uri=上游给的地址: inline=data URL; uri=the URL given by the upstream
inline=平台传字节（data URL）；uri=只给地址，模型自己去取: inline=the platform passes the bytes (data URL); uri=only the URL is given, and the model fetches it itself
不可用时是原因与下一步；**base_url 填错通常表现为 404 而不是 4: The reason and next step when unavailable; **a wrong base_url usually shows up as a 404, not a 401** — the message distinguishes between them
与上游返回同集；顺序按 id 稳定排序: Same set as the upstream response; sorted stably by id
函数参数的形状由调用方定义，是任意 JSON Schema: The shape of the function arguments is defined by the caller, as an arbitrary JSON Schema
厂商私有,平台与别家都不解释: Vendor-specific; neither the platform nor other vendors interpret it
参数形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape of the arguments is determined by that function's JSON Schema, known only at runtime
同 chat，但边生成边产出增量: Same as chat, but streams deltas as it generates
平台据此判断能力降级与 failover: The platform uses this to decide on capability downgrades and failover
平台的 canonical 请求（模型名已解析为上游真名）: The platform's canonical request (the model name has been resolved to its real upstream name)
形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape is determined by that function's JSON Schema, known only at runtime
拿这条凭证问一次上游「有哪些模型」，给部署编辑的模型名下拉用: Uses this credential to ask the upstream for its model list once, for the model-name dropdown in the deployment editor
拿这条凭证问一次上游的模型列表，验证 key 与 base_url 都对: Uses this credential to query the upstream's model list once, to verify the key and base_url are both correct
按 canonical 请求调用上游模型，返回完整回答: Calls the upstream model with the canonical request and returns the complete reply
模型产出的图 / 音频等（inline=data URL，uri=地址）；只在请: Images / audio etc. produced by the model (inline=data URL, uri=URL); only present when the corresponding output modality was requested
由调用方给出，形状随其业务而定: Given by the caller; its shape depends on the caller's own use case
结构化输出的结果，形状由调用方给的 JSON Schema 决定: The structured-output result, shaped according to the caller's JSON Schema
请求的推理语义被就近执行时的一句提示（如 GLM-5.3 家族关不掉思考）；空: A note shown when the requested reasoning semantics were approximated (e.g. the GLM-5.3 family can't turn off thinking); empty = executed faithfully
部署级透传给上游的额外 body 字段，形状由上游 API 决定: Extra body fields passed straight through to the upstream at the deployment level; the shape is determined by the upstream API
